title: On the Regularization of Primal-Dual Dynamics in Time-Dependent Nonconvex Optimization
summary: We study continuous-time primal-dual dynamics for tracking solutions of time-dependent constrained optimization problems. First, for uniformly strongly convex-strongly concave saddle functions, we establish explicit finite-time tracking and additive-disturbance bounds. For convex problems, we then introduce a directional primal regularization, combined with dual Tikhonov regularization, and quantify the resulting optimization bias and constraint violation.
